rightsReview.reason: Reviewed carrier privacy policy and current route rights footer. No raw expression redistribution grant claimed. Independently structure minimum actual ordered calls from first outbound and inbound columns, both daily September1-October24 2026. Retain pickup-only airport-bound intermediate calls and dropoff-only airport-origin intermediate calls. Exact P11 same-operator road components only; no clocks/fares/frequency or copied source layout. Current carrier explicitly identifies Aomori11 and airport2. Day-of flight-related schedule changes remain possible; no connection promise.

The separate noncommercial 2010 edition is excluded.
